Geographies Served Programs Solvathon Programme This Hackathon is an exclusive event organised by Solve Ninja, aimed at public problem solvers. It spans over 1-2 days and brings together teams from schools and colleges to collaborate, build prototypes, and showcase civic solutions to the Solve network. The event provides a platform for participants to learn, experiment, and network with peers and experts, taking public problem-solving to the next level. It encourages innovation and creativity in finding solutions to societal challenges, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment for participants to develop their ideas and make a positive impact in their communities. Solve Bootcamps Programme Reap Benefit conducts boot camps in schools and colleges, training students in public problem-solving on themes like water, sanitation, and waste. The camps offered range from a 6-month program to 3-day courses. Solve Bootcamp Build 1 community is a 3-6 month programme. Solve Bootcamp Express is an expedited 3-day workshop. Solve Bootcamp Residential is a 2-3 day residential programme. These boot camps seek to equip students with critical problem-solving skills, critical thinking, empathy and other related skills. Mentors guide students, with special Solve Ninja Toolkits and students are awarded certificates upon completion of the course. Milestones & Track Record Reap Benefit was selected as a 2022 WISE Awards winner, recognized as one of the top 50 last-mile COVID responders by the World Economic Forum in 2021, and featured in Forbes India's '30 Under 30' list in 2014. --> --> Leadership Team Kuldeep Dantewadia Co - Founder Gautam Prakash Co - Founder Kalyan Banerjee Board Member & Advisor Vishal Talreja Board Member & Advisor Rajiv Prakash Board Member & Advisor Mekin Maheswari Board Member & Advisor Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTR2496M Registration Number DIT(E)BLR/12A/K-30/AACTR2496M CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2017/0166203 --> 80G AACTR2496MF20149 12A AACTR2496ME20182 FCRA 094421729 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2012 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Men --> Impact Reap Benefit has achieved impacts through its programmes, with 83% of Solve Ninjas recognizing the crucial role of citizens in governance, 75% taking civic actions, 50% reporting community problems to local authorities, 60% developing civic solutions, and 82% expressing a desire to continue working together, moreover, the Solve Ninja initiative has activated 52,018 participants, diverting 6,65,000 tonnes of waste, collecting 825,000 data points, saving 1,712,812 units of energy, conserving 5,43,29,512 litres of water, building 337 civic innovations, dedicating 6,30,000 hours to public problem-solving, and taking 60,000 civic actions. Vision and Mission Reap Benefit's mission is to build a nation-wide movement of 10 million first-mile changemakers called Solve Ninjas by 2030, redefining climate and civic leadership through impactful hyper-local actions.
